channel.title: The Grant Desk - UK, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: UK, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: Alpaca Festival 2027: Open Call for Pattern-Based Performances, Workshops and Talks (Sheffield, UK)
item.description: Pattern Club (Alpaca Festival) · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · Performances: artist fee plus national travel expenses. Workshops: artist fee, materials expenses and national travel expenses. Fee amounts are not yet confirmed (tight budget); additional costs may be covered on request. International travel is not covered beyond a small European train budget. Conference talks: no fee or expenses, in-person speakers get a free festival weekend pass and lunch on 6 and 7 May. No application fee.

item.title: Pivotal Research Fellowship (2027 Q1)
item.description: Pivotal Research · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · £15,000 to £18,000 stipend (£18,000 for senior fellows, e.g. PhD, industry track record or strong publications) + travel to and from London + £1,800/month housing for non-London fellows + weekday lunch and dinner + compute.

item.title: Shape Arts: Emergent Residency 2026/27 (Tate St Ives / Porthmeor Studios)
item.description: Shape Arts, with Tate St Ives · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · GBP 3,000 bursary for the selected residency artist (restricted to artists living or working in Cornwall, Devon or Somerset). Disabled artists in the rest of the UK can join the shortlisted cohort, which brings mentoring and profile but no stated bursary. No application fee.

item.title: BRAID Creative Commissions 2027: A Promise in Return (Responsible AI, GBP 8,000-12,000, Edinburgh Art Festival)
item.description: BRAID (Bridging Responsible AI Divides), University of Edinburgh, with Inspace, the Institute for Design Informatics and the Edinburgh Futures Institute · deadline 02 Nov 2026 · Around seven commissions with budgets of GBP 8,000 to 12,000 each, inclusive of VAT and all costs. No application fee.

item.title: Arts Council England: National Lottery Project Grants (rolling)
item.description: Arts Council England · deadline Rolling / undated · GBP 1,000 to GBP 100,000 per project. Decisions in about 8 weeks for requests up to GBP 30,000, about 12 weeks above that. No application fee.

item.title: Creative Scotland: Open Fund for Individuals (rolling)
item.description: Creative Scotland · deadline Rolling / undated · GBP 500 to GBP 50,000 (two levels: up to GBP 20,000 with decisions in 10 weeks, GBP 20,001 to 50,000 in 14 weeks). National Lottery funded. No application fee.

item.title: Tate x Delfina Foundation: Brooks International Fellowship Programme 2027 (London)
item.description: Tate and Delfina Foundation · deadline 21 Oct 2026 · Non-salaried but fully supported: return economy-class flight, UK airport transfers, visa fee reimbursement and visa support via Delfina Foundation, a living allowance bursary of GBP 40 per day, a London Underground and bus travel pass, a single bedroom at Delfina Foundation with shared facilities, and travel to other Tate galleries and UK/European cultural institutions. The Leonora Carrington fellowship adds a research resource allowance. No application fee.

item.title: Bradford Textile Society: Design Competition 2026-27 (UK)
item.description: Bradford Textile Society · deadline 07 May 2027 · A collective GBP 17,000 in awards across a wide spectrum of textile specialities. No entry fee is stated on the competition page.

item.title: UK Games Fund: Content Fund (rolling expressions of interest)
item.description: UK Games Fund (UK Games Talent and Finance CIC, backed by DCMS) · deadline Rolling / undated · GBP 100,000 to 250,000 per project as a non-repayable grant for commercial games-for-entertainment content. Paid 70/30: the final 30 percent is released once third-party leverage funding is secured within the same financial year. No application fee.

item.title: The Elephant Trust: Autumn 2026 Grant Round (UK)
item.description: The Elephant Trust · deadline 18 Oct 2026 · Grants to visual artists of up to GBP 5,000; typical awards range GBP 2,000 to GBP 5,000. Projects with a total budget exceeding GBP 30,000 are not supported. No application fee.

item.title: Asymmetry Assistant Curator Fellowship 2027-2029 at Nottingham Contemporary
item.description: Asymmetry Art Foundation, with Nottingham Contemporary · deadline 25 Oct 2026 · Annual salary of GBP 27,556 for two years, plus pension and National Insurance contributions, annual leave in line with organisational policy plus UK bank holidays, visa and legal fee assistance where required, and a travel and relocation allowance. No application fee.

item.title: Fluxus-CPGA Prize at Frieze London 2026
item.description: Fluxus Art Projects, with the Comite Professionnel des Galeries d'Art and Frieze London · deadline 28 Sep 2026 · GBP 15,000 prize, shared between the artist and their gallery. Participation is free of charge.

item.title: Delfina Foundation x Calouste Gulbenkian Foundation: Open Call for Artists from Portugal and Portuguese-Speaking African Nations (London residency)
item.description: Delfina Foundation, in partnership with the Calouste Gulbenkian Foundation (UK Branch) · deadline 04 Oct 2026 · Twelve-week fully funded residency: a return economy-class flight, airport transfers in the UK, reimbursement of visa fees if required, a living allowance of GBP 40 per day, a materials budget of GBP 1,200, a travel pass for London's public transport network, and a single bedroom with a desk at Delfina Foundation, a house hosting up to eight residents with shared bathrooms, laundry rooms, kitchen, library and dining room. No application fee.

item.title: Institute for Law & AI: Winter Research Fellowship EU Law 2027 (Cambridge, UK)
item.description: Institute for Law & AI (LawAI) · deadline 12 Oct 2026 · GBP 1,000 weekly stipend for the 10-week fellowship (GBP 10,000 total), plus a GBP 7,000 relocation and housing payment. No application fee.

item.title: IAPS: AI Policy Fellowship Spring 2027 (DC, London or remote)
item.description: Institute for AI Policy and Strategy (IAPS) · deadline 27 Sep 2026 · Fellows receive USD 18,000 and Senior Fellows USD 24,000 as a stipend for the three-month full-time program, plus an additional USD 3,000 stipend on the in-person DC or London tracks, healthcare benefits and a USD 500 professional development stipend. Up to 45 fellows. No application fee.

item.title: Brooks International Fellowship Programme 2027 (Tate Britain x Delfina Foundation)
item.description: Tate, in collaboration with Delfina Foundation · deadline 21 Oct 2026 · Fully funded 6-month fellowship: living allowance bursary of GBP 40 per day, single bedroom at Delfina Foundation (house of up to 8 residents with shared facilities), return economy flight, UK airport transfers, visa fee reimbursement with visa support, London Underground and bus travel pass, a research resource allowance, and travel to other Tate galleries (Tate Modern, Liverpool, St Ives) and other UK and European cultural institutions. Two fellowships available. No application fee.

item.title: The Photographers' Gallery: Future of Archives, Whose Archive is it Anyway? (Call for Speakers)
item.description: The Photographers' Gallery · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · GBP 200 speaker fee for each selected speaker. No application fee.

item.title: LASR Labs Winter 2027 (London AI Safety Research)
item.description: LASR Labs, hosted at the London Initiative for Safe AI (LISA) · deadline 20 Sep 2026 · GBP 15,000 stipend for the 13-week programme, plus food, office space, and flights/travel. No application fee.

item.title: ILIAD Fellowship: Mentored AI Alignment Research (November and December 2026 cohorts)
item.description: ILIAD · deadline 21 Sep 2026 · USD 6,000 per month travel-and-housing allowance for the 3-month fellowship. No tuition or application fee.

item.title: University of Oxford: Postdoctoral Research Fellow in Computational Social Science and Text Analysis (CeDR)
item.description: Centre for Democratic Resilience, Department of Politics and International Relations, University of Oxford · deadline 25 Sep 2026 · Salary GBP 39,424 to 51,983 per annum. Full-time, fixed-term for three years. No application fee.

item.title: MATS Residency Program: 6-24 Month Funded AI Safety Research (Winter 2027 intake)
item.description: MATS (ML Alignment and Theory Scholars) · deadline 31 Oct 2026 · USD 155,000 to 285,000 per year gross (set by location, seniority, and experience), plus medical/dental/vision/life insurance, retirement plan, paid time off, conference funding, catered meals, and up to USD 25,000 relocation support. No application fee.

item.title: Open City Documentary Festival 2027 (Call for Entries)
item.description: Open City Documentary Festival / UCL · deadline 27 Nov 2026 · Screening fees for all selected works: GBP 275 for works over 60 min, GBP 140 for works over 40 min, GBP 70 for works under 40 min, GBP 100 for cross-platform projects (all incl. VAT)

item.title: Anthropic Fellows Program (funded AI research fellowship, January 2027 cohort)
item.description: Anthropic (with Constellation as recruiting partner) · deadline Rolling / undated · USD 3,850 / GBP 2,310 / CAD 4,300 per week for four months of full-time research, plus roughly USD 15,000 per month in compute funding and other research expenses. No application fee.

item.title: GMAC Film: Little Pictures 2026/27 (Scotland)
item.description: GMAC Film (Glasgow Media Access Centre) · deadline 09 Sep 2026 · Up to GBP 6,000 production funding per film, plus training, workshops, industry mentorship and free equipment and resource access

item.title: Scottish Documentary Institute: Bridging the Gap 2026/27
item.description: Scottish Documentary Institute, with Screen Scotland and Northern Ireland Screen · deadline 09 Sep 2026 · Up to 4 films receive a full commission with a cash production budget (GBP 8,500 per film in the previous round) plus production and distribution support

item.title: ERA:AI Fellowship 2027 (Winter cohort, Cambridge)
item.description: ERA Fellowship · deadline 13 Sep 2026 · GBP 10,000 stipend for the 10-week fellowship, plus visa support, travel expense coverage and meals during working hours. Top performers can receive 6+ month extensions through the Research Scholars programme. No application fee.

item.title: 2 new grants - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
• BOLD Fellow, British Open-ended Learning and Discovery Lab
    https://eng.ox.ac.uk/jobs/job-detail?vacancyID=187853
    University of Oxford, Department of Engineering Science (BOLD Lab, with UCL and Imperial College London) · deadline 15 Sep 2026 · Salary on Oxford Grade 10R, GBP 65,336 to GBP 84,663 per year, with the posting noting that further salary options are being explored. Benefits include associate membership at Reuben College, 38 days annual leave, pension scheme, childcare services, and travel expenses for stakeholder and conference visits. Fellows also get access to substantial compute: 3 million GPU hours on Isambard for the first 18 months, with the lab working towards 5,000 H100-equivalents in total across industry and government support. No application fee.
  • ILIAD Intensive: Foundational AI Alignment Program (London and Berkeley)
    https://www.iliad.ac/intensive
    ILIAD · deadline Rolling / undated · No tuition. USD 5,000 travel and housing allowance per participant, plus office space at the venue and lunch and dinner five days a week. Cohorts of 15 to 30 participants. Participants arrange and pay for their own travel and accommodation out of the allowance.

    British Council, supported by BFI National Lottery funding in partnership with BFI NETWORK and the BFI International Fund · deadline Rolling / undated · Varies by strand: short and feature film festival grants GBP 150 to 1,500 (typically up to GBP 750); XR travel-only grants GBP 150 to 1,500; large XR grants GBP 1,500 to 5,000; lab grants capped at GBP 6,000; co-production forum grants capped at GBP 2,000. item.title: 3 new grants - week of 03 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Innovate UK: Next Wave Breakthrough Wave 1, Createch (2026)
    https://apply-for-innovation-funding.service.gov.uk/competition/2517/overview/6ff2066d-4639-44e6-bb4f-ce7099222739
    Innovate UK, UK Research and Innovation · deadline 11 Aug 2026 · GBP 100,000 to 500,000 total project costs from a GBP 10 million fund; no organisation may receive more than GBP 3 million across the programme. Grant intervention rates for industrial research: up to 70 percent for micro and small enterprises, 60 percent for medium, 50 percent for large. Research organisations doing non-economic work can claim up to 100 percent, or 80 percent of full economic cost for academic institutions. The balance is match funding. No application fee.
  • Forma: Curator (6-month contract)
    https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfNSVKLQMxPqqwBbc9queqKvBCZqa7ET6cWcyFKOUXk1Ffarg/viewform
    Forma · deadline 16 Aug 2026 · GBP 36,000 pro rata for four days a week (GBP 28,800 actual). No application fee.
  • AHRC: Design Generators Round Two (2026)
    https://www.ukri.org/opportunity/design-generators-round-two/
    Arts and Humanities Research Council (AHRC), UK Research and Innovation · deadline 29 Sep 2026 · GBP 150,000 to 200,000 per project at 100 percent full economic cost; AHRC funds 80 percent and the host research organisation must cover the remaining 20 percent. Total fund GBP 1,000,000, approximately 5 awards. Covers research staff time, design prototyping, partner costs and public engagement activity. Subcontractors and PhD studentships are not fundable. No application fee.
